grade_rationale: 6 P1 findings exceed C threshold (max_p1=2). Spec coverage 93.1% is healthy. Dependency vulnerability load is the primary driver of grade.

summary.skip_reason: Services not running — static mode only

escalations.title: proxy-addr IP Spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6
escalations.failure_scenario: Attacker sends request with IPv4-mapped IPv6 address → proxy-addr misidentifies source IP → IP-based access controls bypassed; auth middleware trusts forged IP
escalations.impact: Authentication bypass, IP-based access control circumvention
escalations.recommendation: npm update proxy-addr (>= 2.0.8) in Source/Backend and platform/orchestrator

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection via @partial-block
escalations.failure_scenario: Attacker controls template input containing @partial-block syntax → Handlebars evaluates arbitrary JavaScript in server context → remote code execution
escalations.impact: Server-side template injection, arbitrary code execution on backend host
escalations.recommendation: npm update handlebars in Source/Backend; audit all template call sites; remove handlebars if unused

escalations.title: tinypool Prototype Pollution Remote Code Execution
escalations.failure_scenario: Attacker injects malicious object with __proto__ properties into tinypool worker context → prototype chain poisoned → arbitrary code runs in test runner or build pipeline
escalations.impact: Remote code execution in test environment and CI/CD pipeline
escalations.recommendation: npm update tinypool vitest in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read and Code Execution
escalations.failure_scenario: Vitest UI server is exposed on portal/Frontend → attacker requests /@fs/etc/passwd or crafted path → reads arbitrary files; with write primitives, executes code
escalations.impact: Arbitrary file disclosure from server filesystem; potential code execution
escalations.recommendation: npm update vitest; disable Vitest UI in production; bind UI server to localhost only

escalations.title: protobufjs Code Injection via Bytes Field Defaults
escalations.failure_scenario: Orchestrator receives malformed protobuf message with crafted bytes field default → protobufjs evaluates embedded code during deserialization → code injection in orchestrator process
escalations.impact: Code injection in orchestrator via untrusted protobuf messages
escalations.recommendation: npm update protobufjs in platform/orchestrator; validate all proto schema sources; never load untrusted .proto files

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search endpoint not registered — DependencyPicker typeahead broken end-to-end
p1_findings.failure_scenario: User opens DependencyPicker → types search query → frontend calls GET /api/search?q=… → backend returns 404 (route not registered) → picker shows no results → dependency cannot be set via UI
p1_findings.impact: FR-dependency-search completely non-functional; feature shipped but broken
p1_findings.recommendation: Register search route in app.ts; add route handler in routes/workItems.ts or new search.ts module; test contract already written at Source/Backend/tests/routes/search.test.ts

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration Prometheus histogram missing (FR-dependency-metrics)
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Operator queries GET /metrics → dependencyCheckDuration_seconds histogram absent → no latency visibility into slow BFS cycle detection
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Histogram to metrics.ts; instrument hasUnresolvedBlockers / isReady functions

p2_findings.title: Route handlers bypass service layer — direct store imports in 3 route files
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Developer adds validation logic to workItemService.createWorkItem() → all 3 routes bypass it via direct store call → validation silently skipped for all entry points
p2_findings.recommendation: Introduce workItemService.ts wrapping store CRUD; update route handlers to call service layer

p2_findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js Server Crash via Malformed Requests + Certificate Validation Bypass
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker sends malformed gRPC request to orchestrator → server crashes (DoS); separate path: TLS certificate validation bypassed allowing MITM

p2_findings.title: body-parser Denial of Service via Invalid Content-Length
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker sends request with crafted Content-Length header → body-parser hangs or crashes → all HTTP endpoints on affected services unavailable (DoS)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update in all projects to get current express/body-parser versions

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion Zero-Step Sequence Denial of Service
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker crafts brace expression with zero-step sequence (e.g., {0..1000000..0}) → infinite loop in brace-expansion → process hangs
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update brace-expansion to >= 1.1.12 in Source/Backend

p2_findings.title: Browserslist Memory Exhaustion
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Malformed browserslist query string causes memory exhaustion in build toolchain; could affect CI/CD environments
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update browserslist across all projects

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker injects CRLF sequences into form field names → HTTP response splitting possible → header injection attacks
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update form-data across all projects

p2_findings.title: js-yaml Quadratic Complexity Denial of Service
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker submits specially crafted YAML payload to any endpoint that processes YAML → O(n²) parsing loop → CPU exhaustion → DoS
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update js-yaml to >= 3.13.1 in Source/Backend

p2_findings.title: nanoid Non-Cryptographically-Secure Generator Loop Risk
p2_findings.failure_scenario: If nanoid IDs are used for security-sensitive tokens (session, CSRF), predictable output may allow forgery
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update nanoid; audit usage to confirm IDs are not used in security contexts

p2_findings.title: PostCSS XSS via Unescaped </style> Tag
p2_findings.failure_scenario: PostCSS generates CSS containing unescaped </style> → browser prematurely closes style block → HTML injection point opens; XSS if attacker controls CSS content
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update postcss in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p2_findings.title: source-map-js Event Loop Denial of Service
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Processing crafted source maps in build pipeline stalls the Node.js event loop; CI builds hang indefinitely
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update source-map-js in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS via Backtracking Pattern
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker sends URL with specially crafted path to orchestrator → path-to-regexp regex catastrophically backtracks → event loop blocked → all orchestrator requests stall (DoS)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update path-to-regexp to >= 0.1.12 in platform/orchestrator

p2_findings.title: ws Uninitialized Memory Disclosure
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker crafts WebSocket frame with specific mask bytes → ws reads uninitialized memory → partial memory contents returned to client (information disclosure)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update ws to >= 8.18.1 in portal/Frontend

p2_findings.title: Vite Path Traversal in Source Map Handling
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Dev server exposes crafted .map request → Vite resolves path traversal sequences → reads arbitrary files from server filesystem outside project root
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update vite to latest in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p2_findings.title: picomatch Glob Pattern Injection
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker controls glob pattern input → picomatch matches unintended paths → unauthorized file access in build pipeline or file watcher context

p3_findings.title: Traceability enforcer does not cover FR-dependency-* requirements
p3_findings.recommendation: Update enforcer to also scan Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md

p3_findings.title: Two specs in Specifications/ have zero Source/ coverage (Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md, Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md)
p3_findings.recommendation: Add 'Status: Deferred' headers or move to Specifications/deferred/; update CLAUDE.md

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable-next-line without rationale in 2 production files
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline comment explaining why dependency is intentionally omitted; refactor if suppression hides real bug

p3_findings.title: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node pulls 50+ transitive packages
p3_findings.recommendation: Review which instrumentations are needed; use selective @opentelemetry/instrumentation-* imports instead of the meta-package

p3_findings.title: 26 outdated packages across 5 projects; Vite/Vitest ecosystem has recurring vulnerability pattern
p3_findings.recommendation: Enable automated security alerts (Dependabot or npm audit in CI); schedule monthly dependency update sprint; portal/Backend is highest risk (61 vulnerabilities — may need major-version overhaul)

cross_references.single_fix: npm update vite vitest tinypool postcss source-map-js picomatch in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend
npm update express body-parser form-data proxy-addr across Source/Backend, platform/orchestrator
Complete dependency feature implementation: register /api/search route, add dependencyCheckDuration histogram, expand traceability enforcer
cross_references.fix_impact: Resolves 1 P1 + 1 P2 + 1 P3 from quality-oracle
